headlineCollision: A field-odd or sign-changing thermal Hall trace can be produced by hybrid-band Berry curvature or intrinsic many-body skew scattering.

correctedBoundary.disorder: Controlled disorder remains necessary to exclude extrinsic side-jump and impurity-skew backgrounds, but it does not separate the two named mechanisms because the many-body skew mechanism is itself disorder-free.
correctedBoundary.linewidth: Linewidth is a shared constraint and consistency check, not a unique mechanism label.
correctedBoundary.signChange: A sign change is not a unique tag of hybrid-band geometry.

activationAudit.model: log|kappa_xy| = a + p log(T) - n Delta_spec/T, with a and p profiled and Delta_spec measured independently
activationAudit.hybridBandExpectation: n approximately 1 for a leading one-quasiparticle Berry-curvature contribution
activationAudit.manyBodySkewExpectation: n approximately 2 in the low-temperature asymptotic derived for the magnon collision mechanism
activationAudit.gapCalibrationRule: A fractional bias in Delta_spec produces the inverse fractional bias in fitted n; the spectroscopic gap and its covariance must therefore enter the joint fit.

movingCrossingAudit.intervention: Tune a phonon frequency by isotope, strain or another lattice-native control while measuring the magnon and phonon spectra on the same specimen.
movingCrossingAudit.residualCoordinate: Remove the measured direct magnon shift, then compare the Hall-feature shift with the measured avoided-crossing shift.
movingCrossingAudit.interpretation: A hybrid-band contribution should track the moving anticrossing; a pure magnon-skew contribution has no necessary phonon-locking. Mixed mechanisms give an intermediate, temperature-dependent ratio.

minimumExecutableBundle: same-specimen field- and temperature-resolved kappa_xx and kappa_xy
same-specimen magnon and phonon spectroscopy resolving the relevant gap and avoided crossing
a low-temperature activation fit with the spectroscopic gap frozen rather than inferred from Hall data
a lattice-native phonon-moving intervention with the magnetic-spectrum shift retained as a nuisance control
linewidth, geometry, contact, magnetization, domain and disorder records
a held-out temperature or intervention setting and a joint mixture fit allowing both mechanisms

decision.hybridSupported: activation order near one and nuisance-corrected Hall-feature tracking ratio near one
decision.skewSupported: activation order near two and tracking ratio near zero, with collision phase space and linewidth jointly consistent
decision.mixtureOrUnresolved: intermediate or temperature-dependent coordinates, or either coordinate unstable to the declared nuisance model
decision.killTest: If both mechanisms remain freely refittable after the independently measured gap and moving-crossing intervention, report the detector-equivalence class rather than assigning geometry.
